items.title: Brian Thomas: Practicing Wednesday, but not taking contact
items.description:
Thomas (shoulder) was present on the field for Wednesday's joint practice with the Buccaneers while sporting a no-contact jersey, John Shipley of SI.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Calvin Austin: Tears ACL, out for season
items.description:
Austin is expected to miss the 2026 season after he sustained a torn ACL in his right knee while running a route during Tuesday's practice, Jordan Raanan of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Ja'Marr Chase: Says he could play through knee injury
items.description:
Chase (knee) said he could play in a game Wednesday after exiting Tuesday's practice early, Kelsey Conway of the Cincinnati Enquirer reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Ja'Marr Chase: Downplays knee injury
items.description:
Chase downplayed his knee injury Tuesday, saying it was a "little hyperextension," and he could've kept practicing, Kelsey Conway of the Cincinnati Enquirer reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Chris Olave: Exits practice early Tuesday
items.description:
Olave exited Tuesday's practice early with an undisclosed injury, Mike Triplett of New Orleans.Football reports.
